think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation/source comments for any sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/special mode) rather than just scaling behavior. 3) Determine whether any value breaks the natural numeric ordering by switching the knob into a qualitatively different mode. 4) If such a sentinel exists, mark as special and record the value; otherwise mark as not special.
